sentences.zh: 但我认为这不仅仅是有趣。

sentences.en: Mike's project points to the fact that there just aren't too many companies whose very name
sentences.zh: 迈克的项目指出了一个事实，那就是没有多少公司的名字

sentences.en: describes their own signature brand of mass-produced architecture that they themselves inhabit.
sentences.zh: 能直接描述他们自己所居住的量产建筑风格。

sentences.en: Although Pizza Hut never meant for architecture to be the focus of their brand.
sentences.zh: 尽管披萨小屋从未想过让建筑成为其品牌的焦点。

sentences.en: At least, not at firSt.
sentences.zh: 至少起初不是。

sentences.en: Pizza Hut was founded in 1958 in Wichita, Kansas.
sentences.zh: 披萨小屋于1958年在堪萨斯州威奇托成立。

sentences.en: It was actually founded by two brothers who were students at Wichita State University.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是由两名威奇托州立大学的学生兄弟创立的。

sentences.en: And with that, you know, 56 years later, it's grown into the world's largest pizza company
sentences.zh: 就这样，56年后，它发展成了世界上最大的披萨公司，

sentences.en: with more than 14,000 restaurants around the world.
sentences.zh: 在全球拥有超过14000家餐厅。

sentences.en: Doug Turfer is the public relations director at Pizza Hut.
sentences.zh: 道格·特弗是披萨小屋的公关总监。

sentences.en: He says that when Pizza Hut's founders, the brothers Frank and Dan Carney, bought their first building,
sentences.zh: 他说，当披萨小屋的创始人，弗兰克·卡尼和丹·卡尼兄弟买下第一栋建筑时，

sentences.en: they got a sign that only had room for eight letters.
sentences.zh: 他们拿到的招牌只有八个字母的空间。

sentences.en: It had room for pizza on top, but it only had room for three characters or three letters underneath that.
sentences.zh: 上面有放“披萨”的空间，但下面只有三个字符或三个字母的空间。

sentences.en: And any Scrabble player knows that there are really only so many three-letter words.
sentences.zh: 任何玩过拼字游戏的人都知道，三个字母的单词其实没几个。

sentences.en: Pizza dad, pizza sad, pizza eel.
sentences.zh: 披萨爸爸，披萨悲伤，披萨鳗鱼。

sentences.en: And they kind of looked at the shape of their building and thought,
sentences.zh: 他们看着建筑的形状，心想，

sentences.en: well, it kind of looks like a hut, so maybe we call it Pizza Hut.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它看起来有点像个小屋，所以也许我们叫它披萨小屋。

sentences.en: So if they had four letters, maybe it would have been called Pizza Shed?
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们有四个字母的空间，也许它会被叫作披萨棚？

sentences.en: Yeah, Pizza Zone, pizza something like that.
sentences.zh: 是啊，披萨地带，披萨之类的名字。

sentences.en: No, the original Pizza Hut is still around, though not in operation.
sentences.zh: 不，最初的披萨小屋还在，虽然已经不营业了。

sentences.en: It's an up path.
sentences.zh: 它是个小屋。

sentences.en: It's been moved to the campus of the founder's alma mater, Wichita State.
sentences.zh: 它被搬到了创始人母校威奇托州立大学的校园里。

sentences.en: Just outside their school of entrepreneurialism.
sentences.zh: 就在他们的创业学院外面。

sentences.en: The first Pizza Hut is commemorated with a plaque.
sentences.zh: 第一家披萨小屋立了一块牌匾以示纪念。

sentences.en: And if not for that plaque, you'd have no idea what it is.
sentences.zh: 如果不是那块牌匾，你根本不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: It just looks like a tiny brick house, nary a trapezoid anywhere.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像个小砖房，哪有什么梯形。

sentences.en: Pizza Hut's signature look came later.
sentences.zh: 披萨小屋的标志性外观是后来才有的。

sentences.en: That was the work of an architect, a friend and classmate of the Carney brothers.
sentences.zh: 那是卡尼兄弟的朋友兼同学，一位建筑师的作品。

sentences.en: A guy by the name of Richard Burke.
sentences.zh: 一个叫理查德·伯克的人。

sentences.en: Burke wanted $32,000 to do the design.
sentences.zh: 伯克要价32000美元来做设计。

sentences.en: The Carnies counter-offered with $100 per Pizza Hut to subsequently open.
sentences.zh: 卡尼兄弟还价为每开一家披萨小屋支付100美元。

sentences.en: Burke accepted and created a lot of the features that we can now recognize today,
sentences.zh: 伯克接受了，并创造了许多我们今天能认出来的特征，

sentences.en: irrefutably, as Pizza Huts.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，那就是披萨小屋。

sentences.en: And from there, Pizza Hut's architecture and their corporate image became intertwined.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，披萨小屋的建筑和企业形象就交织在了一起。

sentences.en: And so the Carnies and their franchisees began lining the American landscape with hut after hut after hut.
sentences.zh: 于是卡尼兄弟和他们的加盟商开始在美洲大地上建起一座又一座小屋。

sentences.en: But in their ascendancy, Pizza Hut couldn't or simply wouldn't imagine a time
sentences.zh: 但在鼎盛时期，披萨小屋无法或根本不愿想象一个时代，

sentences.en: when the people would not come out in droves to enjoy a personal pan pizza or a zesty breadstick.
sentences.zh: 那时人们不会成群结队地出来享用个人装披萨或美味面包棒。

sentences.en: As market trends shifted away from the dining experience and on to delivery, many Pizza Huts closed.
sentences.zh: 随着市场趋势从堂食体验转向外卖，许多披萨小屋关闭了。

sentences.en: And as their trapezoidal windows went dark and their roof humps rose up over empty parking lots,
sentences.zh: 当他们的梯形窗户变暗，屋顶隆起在空荡荡的停车场上空时，

sentences.en: it was as if the company had littered the world with monuments to its own decline.
sentences.zh: 就好像该公司在世界上留下了自己衰落的纪念碑。

sentences.en: It reminds you that there used to be Pizza Huts everywhere and that there aren't anymore.
sentences.zh: 这提醒你，曾经到处都是披萨小屋，而现在不再有了。

sentences.en: We see the old Pizza Huts laying around, sort of the dead carcasses along the road.
sentences.zh: 我们看到旧的披萨小屋散落在各处，就像路边的死尸一样。

sentences.en: And now Pizza Hut's architectural legacy is one that will remind passersby of the company's failure to thrive
sentences.zh: 现在，披萨小屋的建筑遗产将提醒路人，该公司在每一个它曾经失败的地方，

sentences.en: in every single place it ever failed to thrive.
sentences.zh: 都未能兴旺发展。

sentences.en: But Doug Turfer of Pizza Hut, he thinks that ut-baths are a triumph.
sentences.zh: 但披萨小屋的道格·特弗认为，这些小屋建筑是一种胜利。

sentences.en: We're pretty proud of the fact that our business became so recognizable
sentences.zh: 我们很自豪我们的业务变得如此具有辨识度，

sentences.en: that you can just look at a building and recognize that even as it got turned into something
sentences.zh: 以至于你只要看一眼建筑，就能认出它，即使它已经被改造成了别的东西，

sentences.en: and then maybe even turned over into something else again,
sentences.zh: 甚至可能又被改造成了其他东西，

sentences.en: that when you just look at it, people know that used to be a Pizza Hut.
sentences.zh: 当你看着它时，人们依然知道那曾经是一家披萨小屋。

sentences.en: That's really cool to us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说真的很酷。

sentences.en: I have to say, I think I'm with Doug on this one.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，在这点上我同意道格的看法。

sentences.en: Yes, the hubris of Pizza Hut is the stuff of Greek tragedy.
sentences.zh: 是的，披萨小屋的傲慢简直是希腊悲剧的素材。

sentences.en: But this is not a story about failure.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是一个关于失败的故事。

sentences.en: It's a story about hope, about what can be reclaimed,
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于希望的故事，关于什么可以被重塑，

sentences.en: about the possibilities for what might emerge
sentences.zh: 关于那些可能出现的新可能，

sentences.en: out of what couldn't have ever been dreamed up from the outset.
sentences.zh: 那些最初根本无法想象的可能性。

sentences.en: A mollusk dies and a hermit crab moves into its shell.
sentences.zh: 软体动物死了，寄居蟹搬进了它的壳里。

sentences.en: But Pizza Hut is actually curbing the rise of ut-baths.
sentences.zh: 但披萨小屋实际上正在遏制小屋建筑的兴起。

sentences.en: In the late 1990s and early aughts,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪90年代末和21世纪初，

sentences.en: the company shifted towards a carry-out and delivery model.
sentences.zh: 公司转向了外带和外送模式。

sentences.en: Today, about half the Pizza Huts in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，美国大约一半的披萨小屋

sentences.en: operate out of generic, glass-box-looking structures.
sentences.zh: 在普通的玻璃盒子建筑中运营。

sentences.en: No trapezoids, no sloped roofs.
sentences.zh: 没有梯形，没有斜屋顶。

sentences.en: They don't stand out.
sentences.zh: 它们并不显眼。

sentences.en: In fact, a newer-style Pizza Hut near my apartment just went out of business.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我公寓附近一家新式披萨小屋刚刚倒闭了。

sentences.en: And if I hadn't ever seen it in operation,
sentences.zh: 如果我从未见过它营业，

sentences.en: there'd be no way to know what it once was.
sentences.zh: 根本无法知道它曾经是什么。

sentences.en: Now that I've seen the next generation of faceless used-to-be-a-Pizza Huts,
sentences.zh: 现在我已经看到了下一代面目全非的“前披萨小屋”，

sentences.en: I think that if Pizza Hut phases out their signature buildings,
sentences.zh: 我认为如果披萨小屋淘汰掉他们的标志性建筑，

sentences.en: it will be a huge mistake.
sentences.zh: 那将是一个巨大的错误。

sentences.en: Because Pizza Hut has achieved a level of greatness here.
sentences.zh: 因为披萨小屋在这里达到了一种伟大的高度。

sentences.en: I mean, how many other structures have there ever been in history
sentences.zh: 我是说，历史上还有多少其他建筑，

sentences.en: whose true essence can shine through whatever might come after it?
sentences.zh: 其真正的本质可以在它之后出现的任何事物中闪耀？

sentences.en: If you opened a hamburger joint in the Great Pyramid of Giza,
sentences.zh: 如果你在吉萨大金字塔里开了一家汉堡店，

sentences.en: it will always, first and foremost, be the Great Pyramid of Giza.
sentences.zh: 它永远首先是吉萨大金字塔。

sentences.en: Turn left at the place that used to be the Great Pyramid of Giza.
sentences.zh: 在那个曾经是吉萨大金字塔的地方左转。

sentences.en: Like the pyramid, the Pizza Hut, the humble Pizza Hut,
sentences.zh: 就像金字塔一样，披萨小屋，卑微的披萨小屋，

sentences.en: succeeds in etching its identity onto everything else that will ever come after it.
sentences.zh: 成功地将其身份烙印在之后出现的一切事物上。

sentences.en: It is at that level.
sentences.zh: 它达到了那个高度。

sentences.en: The Pizza Hut manages to constantly remind everyone,
sentences.zh: 披萨小屋设法不断提醒每个人，

sentences.en: hey, I was here.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我曾经在这里。

sentences.en: I am the place with the personal pan pizzas,
sentences.zh: 我就是那个有个人装披萨的地方，

sentences.en: with the translucent red plastic cups,
sentences.zh: 有半透明红色塑料杯的地方，

sentences.en: with the tabletop Pac-Man.
sentences.zh: 有桌面吃豆人游戏的地方。

sentences.en: So let us stand in awe of the mighty Pizza Hut,
sentences.zh: 所以让我们对强大的披萨小屋肃然起敬吧，

sentences.en: which, more than just about any other once-beloved establishment
sentences.zh: 它比几乎任何其他曾经深受喜爱的机构，

sentences.en: since crumbled beneath the sands of time,
sentences.zh: 在时间的沙砾下崩塌之后，

sentences.en: can reach into the future and proclaim,
sentences.zh: 都能伸向未来并宣称，

sentences.en: just try and forget about me.
sentences.zh: 试着忘记我吧。

sentences.en: Just try.
sentences.zh: 尽管试试。
